propositions: Four CI lanes in the Live External Integration workflow fail with AttributeError: module 'rebar.llm' has no attribute 'review_ticket' because the public API was removed pre-1.0 and deprecated tests were missed.

The removed rebar.llm.review_ticket() API was replaced with rebar.llm.review_plan() and rebar.llm.review_code(), but two external test modules still call the removed function and were excluded from the standard Verified gate so the regression went undetected.

The retarget to review_code (not review_plan) is required because review_code returns REVIEW_RESULT with top-level findings/runner/model fields matching existing test assertions, while review_plan returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT with a different schema.
Both test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py must be updated to call review_code with matching assertions and schema validation.
